description: List the rows one user of an app is linked to, oldest first: each link has itemId, source (invite or admin) and createdAt. These are the rows the user "is" under row-level security mode "relation". A user can also stand for a row with no link at all, through identityPhoneColumn or identityEmailColumn; those matches are computed on every request and do not appear here.

appId.description: App id or slug (from list_apps / create_app)

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

userId.description: The user's id (userId from list_app_users), a UUID

name: list_app_user_links
